title: Canonical Telemetry Reading
description: The JSON payload published (retained) to ms/<site>/<device>/<channel>/<metric>. One reading per metric per channel. Kept small: the metric key lives in the topic, not the payload.

t.description: Measurement time at the source, UTC epoch milliseconds. Set by the device/edge, NOT the cloud — this is what makes store-and-forward reconciliation correct.

v.description: Value expressed in the metric's canonical unit (see metrics.yaml). Adapters convert before publishing.

u.description: UCUM unit code. Optional (implied by the metric registry) but SHOULD be sent for self-describing streams; if present it MUST equal the registry unit.

q.description: Quality flag. 'stale' = last-known replayed after an outage; 'estimated' = interpolated/derived; 'simulated' = demo/synthetic.

src.description: Energy source for carbon attribution. grid → Scope 2; generator → Scope 1. Omit for non-energy metrics.

seq.description: Monotonic per-(device,channel,metric) sequence number. Lets consumers detect gaps and lets the edge replay buffered readings in order after reconnect.
